headline: KRAKATOA ISLAND ANNIHILATED IN MIGHTIEST ERUPTION OF MODERN TIMES
dispatch: The volcanic island of Krakatoa in the Dutch East Indies was obliterated on Monday in a series of cataclysmic explosions, the greatest of which was heard as far away as Australia and the island of Rodrigues near Mauritius. Tsunamis reaching 30 metres in height swept surrounding coastlines, destroying towns and killing tens of thousands. A vast cloud of ash darkened skies across the region for days, and observers worldwide report vivid red sunsets they cannot explain.
answer: Krakatoa erupts catastrophically, heard 5,000 km away, 1883
